indication: Hypertension; heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF); diabetic nephropathy; post-MI cardioprotection
formularyNotes: Preferred ACE inhibitor for hypertension and HFrEF. Lisinopril and enalapril are both Tier 1. ARBs (losartan, valsartan) are Tier 1–2 alternatives for ACE-intolerant patients (typically cough). ARNI (sacubitril/valsartan — Entresto) is Tier 4 Specialty with PA.
clinicalAlerts: Risk of angioedema — educate patient; contraindicated with sacubitril/valsartan within 36 hours
Monitor potassium and renal function at initiation and dose changes
